title: Adaptive Collaboration of Arena-Based Argumentative LLMs for Explainable and Contestable Legal Reasoning
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing a neuro-symbolic framework for legal reasoning (ACAL) and evaluates its performance on the LegalBench benchmark using specific legal tasks (Hearsay and Courts). It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, spiritual traditions, or ethical/moral systems beyond general mentions of 'fairness' and 'trust' in a legal context.
